evidenceRefs.observation: Legible invoice from Aurora Store for an Aurora Tab 10 (AUR-TAB10), serial AT10-24-0010, 450.00 USD, dated 2026-03-01 as stated in the claim.
Front photo: screen off; no cracks, dents, swelling or liquid marks.
Back photo: serial label shows AT10-24-0010, matching the claim.

structuredOutput.reasoningSummary: The evidence is consistent: the invoice (EV-1) matches the claimed seller, model, serial, price and the purchase date 2026-03-01, and the photos (EV-2, EV-3) show the claimed unit without physical damage. The failure is the battery. For this purchase date policy version 1 applies, whose battery clause POL-3 covers the battery for 6 months from purchase; warranty_lookup confirms the claim date is outside the battery period. A battery fault would otherwise be a covered defect (POL-8). Recommend rejection.
structuredOutput.claimantExplanation: Thank you for your claim for your Aurora Tab 10. Under the Aurora Limited Warranty that applied when you bought your tablet, the battery is covered for 6 months from the purchase date. Your tablet was purchased on 1 March 2026, so the battery coverage has ended and this battery replacement is not covered. An Aurora service center can still offer a paid battery replacement.
